detail.longDescription: Seems like all of the well-supported low-level languages are falling prey to slop now. I just found commits of actual LLM-generated code merged into Rust. GCC has merged quite a bit of LLM-assisted code, even in non-language-specific areas, which means that C, C++, Ada, Go, etc. are all affected. What languages are even available to those of us who want to avoid "AI" in our toolchain, and don't want to use an unproven project? # programming # gcc # rust # ada # llvm # noai
